# InfoAidTech
> Professional IT services, custom software engineering, scalable cloud solutions, and enterprise SME ERP development.

InfoAidTech is a software technology firm specializing in custom web and mobile applications, high-performance API architectures, cloud infrastructure consulting, and enterprise software systems.

## Core Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://infoaidtech.net/service): Enterprise software engineering, scalable web architectures, full-stack application development, and systems integration.
- [Cloud & DevOps Consulting](https://infoaidtech.net/service): Cloud-native architecture design, CI/CD automation, serverless deployments, and infrastructure scaling.
- [Mobile Application Development](https://infoaidtech.net/service): Modern cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using Flutter and React Native.

## Developer Utilities
- [Conventional Commit Generator](https://infoaidtech.net/conventional-commit-generator): Free developer tool for generating structured Conventional Commits with scopes, types, breaking changes, and standard formatting.
- [Image Converter & Optimizer](https://infoaidtech.net/image-converter): High-performance client-side image conversion and compression utility supporting WebP, PNG, and JPEG.
- [JSON to TypeScript Converter](https://infoaidtech.net/json-to-ts): Automatic TypeScript type and interface generator from JSON payloads.

## Technical Blog & Documentation
- [Engineering Blog & Insights](https://infoaidtech.net/blog): In-depth articles covering software architecture, modern frontend frameworks (Angular, React, Vue), cloud engineering, and technical SEO.
